summary: Decorative placeholder shape shown while content loads.

usage.text: The lines attribute repeats the bar as a text block with a shorter last line. It repeats circles too, so keep lines at 1 for shape="circle". Animation is off unless animated is set.
Shapes rect and text draw the same bar: size sets its height (0.75 to 1rem) and the host's width sets its width, so size the host with CSS to match the content it stands in for.

a11y.text: It always sets aria-hidden="true" on itself, so convey the loading state elsewhere, for example aria-busy on the region being loaded or a visible status.
